then.say: Hm. You're the one from the wagon. Bede. I split the wood.
Found this in the woodpile. Somebody hid it and died, I expect. You'll use it better than me.
The carts from the Works stopped coming. Good. I never liked what the smoke smelled of.

else.say: Wood's wet. Everything's wet. The Drip gets into the grain of it. Burns with a hiss, like it's sorry.
